Anant Singh News: mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ka aaj tilak samaroh hai sham 4:00 baje hajaron ki sankhya men unke samarthak aur chahne vale aur parivar ke log tilak samaroh men danapur ke ek risort men jane ke lie niklenge lekin anant sinh ke ghore ke prati prem aur ghurasvari ka junun in sab par bhari hai jahan unke sare log tilak ki taiyari men jute hue hai vahi anant sinh shadi ke din hone vale ghora res ki taiyari ko dekh rahe dekhie Video
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
